protocol.sample: one round-3 threshold-0 decision per match, all 1280 matches
protocol.target: each relative opponent played a combination family in immediately previous round; public actions only
protocol.target_selection: retain family only if both seats have training weighted prevalence in [0.05,0.95]; no validation/test selection
protocol.layers: raw counts; embedding; public encoder layers 1..4; final stream norm; native cached reader and state
protocol.pooling: mean previous-round play tokens separately for each relative opponent; this grants explicit public position/seat pooling to probes
protocol.common_context: frozen own query and state from current-round-only public prefix

probe.architecture: common context + standardized layer feature -> 64 ReLU -> multi-label logits

reader.trainable: q_proj, both halves of kv_proj, out_proj, plus diagnostic head; encoder/private query/action head frozen
reader.normalization: per-head projected Q/K LayerNorm with no affine parameters; no reset of pretrained projections
reader.head: train-only standardized reader output -> 64 ReLU -> multi-label logits
reader.optimizer: Adam, no weight decay, clip global norm 1; fresh optimizer in all arms
reader.selection: validation balanced BCE chooses checkpoint every 200 steps and rate; heldout labels scored only after all choices sealed

protocol.controls: current-round-only inputs and donor old history with own current suffix/query fixed; donor within split and same team, excluding paired deal
protocol.objective: mean per-label class-balanced BCE, with class/sample weights from training matches only
protocol.primary: macro balanced accuracy and balanced BCE on heldout matches, 160 paired seed clusters; report 3 training seeds separately
protocol.budget: CPU only, <=4 worker processes, one torch thread; 3 seeds x 2 rates x 4 arms x 2000 steps maximum, frozen probes 3 x 1000 per layer
protocol.limitation: fact retrieval is an artificial dense-supervision diagnostic, not strategic adaptation or playing-strength acceptance

token_protocol.reason: mean pooling can discard decodable token information; inspect whole memory bank before interpreting layer failure
token_protocol.planned_after: pooled-probe and reader validation curves, before reading heldout scores
token_protocol.scope: six frozen layers, 3 seeds, 1000 steps, batch 256, Adam 0.001, class-balanced action-type CE
token_protocol.targets: 11 public Play action types; only previous-round opponent tokens
token_protocol.aggregation: token argmax, then any token in family for each relative opponent; no tuned aggregation thresholds
token_protocol.selection: validation token CE every 100 steps; match split inherited; heldout tokens never used for selection

summary.metric: macro per-fact balanced accuracy; constant prediction gives 50%; means over three optimization seeds
summary.uncertainty: 5000 bootstrap draws, resample eight paired seed clusters within each of 20 fixed types; preserves both teams; optimization seeds not independent data
summary.limitation: Pooled probes have explicit previous-round/seat masks; token decoding has per-token type supervision and deterministic aggregation; reader training only has match-level binary facts. These are different diagnostic readouts, not equal-capacity policy comparisons.

validation: 23 passed in 1.47s; all 1280 public-log label sets independently matched; source and raw hashes unchanged
